notes: SqueekChainToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named SqueekChain (SQK) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 SQK once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. There are no application contracts, transfer fees, post-construction mint functions or administrative controls. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
